description:
Tailor your resume to every job, with AI help when you want it.

Rezumate is an ATS resume checker for iPhone. Import a PDF or DOCX resume, paste the job description, and see what to fix before you apply.

CHECK YOUR JOB MATCH

See an ATS-style match score based on keyword coverage, impact, structure, and formatting risk, with a clear explanation of each part.

FIND MISSING KEYWORDS

See which skills, tools, and role terms from the job are missing from your resume. Tap one you actually have to add it to Skills or to a bullet you choose, and watch your score update.

IMPROVE WITH AI (REZUMATE PRO)

- Rewrite weak bullets into clear, results-focused lines
- Improve Resume: review every AI change line by line before you accept it
- Add a quick detail, like a number or result, and Rezumate uses it in the rewrite
- Write a cover letter from your real experience
- Find extra requirements hidden in the job description

Rezumate never invents skills, metrics, employers, or experience. If a bullet needs a detail only you know, it asks you instead.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Scoring, keyword matching, and PDF export run on your iPhone, and your resumes are stored only on your device. AI features run only when you tap them; your name, contact details, and profile links are removed before anything is sent. No account needed.

EXPORT

Save tailored versions for different jobs and export a clean, ATS-friendly PDF.

FREE AND PRO

Free includes daily analyses and improvements, saved variants, PDF export, and a few AI actions to try. Rezumate Pro adds unlimited analyses, improvements, and saved variants, the full score breakdown, and AI features (up to 150 AI actions a month), billed monthly or yearly.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.rezumate.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.rezumate.app/privacy

Rezumate gives resume-writing guidance. It cannot guarantee interviews, job offers, or ATS results. Always review your resume and keep every detail accurate.
